Source variable names restored for §3.1#20,#46 and§3.5#55,#56,#58.
assessmentLimitations: Selected results, derivative formulas, numerical values and conclusions are checkable; drawings, proofs and open-ended explanations are not automatically graded.

§3.8ANH project gives two explicitly labeled withdrawal protocols because the source wording does not specify timing; those alternative checks do not grant full task completion.
§3.9#46 assumes a wheel tangent to the ground because no clearance is specified.
§3.9#49 checks magnitude and both possible signed branches because direction is unspecified.
§3.10#10 includes the infinite family of disconnected far-field accuracy windows, not just the interval around0.
ProblemsPlus#12 distinguishes at least one orthogonal intersection from every intersection; a horizontal/vertical orthogonal case is included.
ProblemsPlus#34 distinguishes water-level rates immediately before and after full submergence.
